extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional flooring company. Ask about the floor type, area size, subfloor condition, and whether old flooring needs removal. Ask about access, moisture, and whether furniture needs moving. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a specific finish or warranty that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Our insurer is [insurer name] and our policy number is [policy number]. Certificates are available on request before the job.
{price_note} Flooring is priced per square metre, including supply and install. Tell us the room sizes and the floor type you want.

kb.q: What floor types do you install?
kb.a: We install timber, engineered timber, laminate, vinyl, tile, carpet, bamboo, cork, and epoxy floors.
Yes, we remove and dispose of old flooring. Removal is priced per square metre and shown in your quote.
Yes, we check the subfloor and level it where needed before installation. Levelling is quoted separately once we know the condition.
The time depends on the room size and floor type, so we confirm it when we quote. Whole homes take longer than single rooms.

kb.q: Do you sand and polish timber?
kb.a: Yes, we sand, stain, and polish timber floors. We can talk through finish options during the visit.
Yes, we supply and install carpet, and we can include underlay in the quote so you see the full cost.
Yes, we install floor tiles. Tile prices vary with the tile you choose, so tell us the style you want when you book.
Yes, we install vinyl planks and sheets, and we can discuss which type suits the room and how much it gets used.
Yes, we install laminate flooring. We check the subfloor first to make sure it is flat enough to lay on.
Yes, we install epoxy floors, mainly in garages and commercial spaces. The surface needs proper preparation, which we cover in the quote.
We can move furniture for a fee. Tell us when you book so we can plan the time for it.
Yes, we service commercial properties. Commercial work is quoted separately after a site visit.
{warranty_note} Ask us to explain what is covered before the job starts.
We service [service area] and nearby suburbs. Tell us your suburb when you book, and we will confirm whether we cover it.

kb.q: Do I need to be home for flooring work?
kb.a: No, but someone needs to give us access. We can arrange a key handover, and we will confirm the details when we book.

kb.q: How soon can I walk on the new floor?
kb.a: Many floors can be walked on straight away, but adhesive and polish need more time. We tell you the drying time for your floor before we leave.
Yes, we repair scratched or damaged boards and tiles. We check the damage on a visit before quoting the repair.
Yes, we supply and install underlay with most floating floors. We include it in the quote so you can see the total.

compliance.guidance: Check whether a building permit, registration or domestic building insurance applies to the work before you quote. Keep certificates of currency for public liability and any required insurance. Your state regulator sets the rules.
